finalText:
Build clean now, 0 errors.

Two real bugs, both from bundler bump:
- `src/core/options.js`: new bundler sends `retryCount`, code read old `retries` field, undefined.toFixed() crash. Fixed.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js`: new config loader leaves unset flag `undefined` instead of `false`, strict check threw. Now treats `undefined` as `false`.

Remaining 8 warnings are deprecation noise (DEP0142, DEP0198, etc) — not blocking, real issue.
